scope: R34/R15: bounded personal history, unchanged authorization and exact personal PDF reader; no quota, schema, migration, diary, logout or auth transport changes

query.cursor: optional opaque signed position; at most180 characters

response.planes: Existing summary fields retained; at most limit rows
response.next_cursor: Opaque string if more matching rows exist, otherwise null

http.order: fecha_generacion DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC; undated rows remain readable in the final segment

continuation_filters.dated_position: fecha < last_fecha OR (fecha = last_fecha AND id < last_id) OR fecha IS NULL
continuation_filters.undated_position: fecha IS NULL AND id < last_id

http.invalid_cursor: 422 history_cursor_invalid, generic message without echoing cursor, account, profile or parser details
http.authorization: Canonical persisted auth plus existing personal-context check. The same shared reader enforces Plan.gym_id and Cliente.gym_id equal to subject, both soft-delete predicates, and the existing personal profile ID. Inactive profiles retain readable history. No profile is assigned by email or another heuristic.
http.composition: Only GET history is added to api.app, using exactly the web handler and dependencies. The entire personal router is not mounted. Before api.app returned404; that is recorded separately from the web unbounded-history failure.

cursor.encoding: Canonical version1 JSON [version, stored UTC-naive timestamp or null, positive int32 plan ID], Base64URL without padding plus HMAC-SHA256 signature
cursor.binding: Existing SECRET_KEY; domain-separated namespace and persisted subject/profile IDs enter the signature input only. Neither ID enters the payload.
cursor.validation: Length checked before base64/JSON; canonical base64 and JSON; exact types (booleans rejected), valid fixed-precision timestamp, int32 bounds, constant-time signature comparison; no fallback key and no new TTL policy
cursor.authority: A cursor is only a position. Authorization and owner/soft-delete predicates run again on every request. Key rotation invalidates old positions.
cursor.dates: NULL and literal stored timestamps are preserved; no historical timestamp migration or timezone inference occurs.

live_page_semantics: Pages are live read-only queries, not a transaction-spanning snapshot and not a frozen total.
A deleted cursor row does not break continuation; its signed position remains usable. Deleted unseen rows disappear.
A newer insert above the last position appears after an explicit fresh consultation. An older insert below the position may appear on a later page.
No COUNT, OFFSET traversal, automatic full-history fetching, generation or refund occurs. The default query reads51 summary candidates to return50 plus a continuation flag.
ui: Cargar anteriores fetches one page per explicit action; double click while pending sends one request.
Rows append with ID deduplication. An ordinary error retains visible rows and the exact failed position for retry.
An invalidated cursor retains rows and requires Actualizar historial, which explicitly clears the old query and restarts.

Shared personal.read and context checks fence awaits, DTO use, rendering, controls and authorized PDF download. Storage/session events synchronously invalidate rows, counters, positions and calendar; pending old-session results are discarded.
Same-tab changes without an event are detected at the next context check/await/control; this does not add atomic cross-tab credentials or a new auth transport guarantee.
No history, cursor, health DTO or new operation key is persisted in browser storage. Unidentified legacy diary bytes remain untouched.
The existing personal diary calendar, exact plan-ID PDF reader and machine-ACK logout remain in use.
